patch.value: Publish audience-specific change contracts with shared attribution

Project explicitly tagged API-user, operator and agent-behavior facets of delivered items into versioned change contracts. Reuse release selection, section rules and resolution prose; core item metadata owns facet declarations.

Each audience sees only declared facets; missing facets yield omissions rather than invented prose; byte-stable fixtures cover mixed releases; typed SDK and CLI provide compact TOON/JSON and typed refusals with remedies; docs and read-only public tracker validation without git; npm and Bun CI release gates pass.
